summary: Don't use assert in production code since optimized Python strips it; raise exceptions from if checks instead, using AnsibleAssertionError or more specific exceptions, and in modules use AssertionError or fail_json.
questions: Can I use assert statements in Ansible plugin code?
What should a module use instead of assert?

answer_card.title: no-assert test
answer_card.answer_md: `python -O` removes `assert`, so don't use it in production code. Use an `if` that raises: `AnsibleAssertionError` (subclass of `AnsibleError` and `AssertionError`) or something more specific. Modules can't use `AnsibleAssertionError`; raise `AssertionError` or call `module.fail_json`.
